judgments.note: Appeal of a municipal building permit for a single-family residence on a subdivision lot: new housing. The shared decision also decides 227-11-99 and 15-1-00; only the lot 2 / permit #46-99 parts are used.

No explicit 'de novo' statement, but the court held an evidentiary hearing, weighed the evidence against the zoning standards and itself approved the permits 'in this appeal'; no on-the-record procedure mentioned.

Filing date not stated (not taken from the docket number); start bounded by the April 24, 2000 decision. End is the May 23, 2000 denial of the motion to amend; no further appeal is mentioned, but one cannot be ruled out.
Decision and denial of motion to amend observed; nothing pending shown. The decision notes a possible future Rule 60(b) motion only if the federal suit succeeds.
The decision speaks of the permits collectively as building permits for single-family residences; one dwelling for lot 2.
The permit was issued; any intervening ZBA decision and its date are not described. Date unknown.
Madden and Winborn, self-represented; their relationship to the property (neighbors?) is not stated, so unknown.
Contentions were legal (pending subdivision appeal, applicant identity) and the filing fee; appellants offered no evidence on any zoning standard.
